queue_size_scope: sizeof measured on macOS ARM64, not a whole-process memory claim. Each pool still contains 64 x 1560-byte packets; storage is allocated once before hooks.
causality: The original invalid-duration exception precedes construction of the soak fixture and all fault threads. On clean 18b, GCC Og terminates and O1 faults inside ASan. Changing only fixed packet pool storage, same flags, returns the normal FAIL and 0/1 summary in both. This isolates a storage-layout-dependent unwinding failure, not proof of a compiler defect or the cause of historical DATA loss.
cleanup: Peers registers fault cleanup before potentially throwing configuration. Hooks are cleared and fault workers stopped/joined before first socket close, including partial construction. Worker callbacks are published after successful thread construction. Reader RAII joins on producer/thread-creation errors; captured reader exceptions propagate after join.
unchanged_limits: 64 packets/queue, 1500-byte datagrams, 200 ms playout/proof, 3 s outer predicate wait, original faults/rate/crypto/recovery limits; full ASan/UBSan with default options. No library code modified.
negative_controls: The invalid-duration case must exit 1 with a normal FAIL and 0/1 summary. It is an expected failure, not a successful native profile.
